info.title: Perfex CRM REST API
info.description: REST API for Perfex CRM by Themesic Interactive. Authenticate every request with the authtoken header. Lists support page/per_page pagination, sort, fields selection and date-range filters. An MCP server for AI agents is available at POST /api/mcp.

authtoken.name: authtoken
authtoken.description: API token created under Setup > API > API Management

page.name: page
page.description: Page number; enables the {data, meta} envelope. Omit every pagination parameter to keep the plain-array response of API 2.x.

per_page.name: per_page
per_page.description: Rows per page (default 25, max 100). This is the parameter that sizes a page - "limit" is only honoured as an alias when "page" is sent as well, so a bare ?limit= keeps its legacy meaning and does not paginate.

sort.name: sort
sort.description: Comma list of columns; prefix with - for descending (e.g. -datecreated,company)

fields.name: fields
fields.description: Comma list of columns to return (id always included)

created_after.name: created_after
created_after.description: Keep rows created on/after this ISO date

created_before.name: created_before
created_before.description: Keep rows created on/before this ISO date
